ov: نساء محرمات هو فيلم مصري من إنتاج عام 1959، بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار وهدى سلطان، وإخراج محمود ذو الفقار.
plotEn: Tawfiq is a wealthy man who works as a contractor. He was married to Hafiza and they did not have any children, so he adopts Ahmed, who manages his business later. Ahmed became involved in an affair with a playful woman named Mahasin. By chance, Tawfiq meets Mahasen through one of the matchmakers. The situation gets worse when Mahasen becomes pregnant with Ahmed at the same time which he desires her daughter, Laila, without knowing that she is Mahasen's daughter.
